name: Francis Morgan
original_name: フランシス・モーガン
source:
One of the three professors of the Secret Department of the Miskatonic University. [spoiler]The three of them were involved in the creation of "Heart of a Lion", the main power source of the Demonbane.[/spoiler]

His name is derived from H.P. Lovecraft's character of the same name from the novel [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Dunwich_Horror]"The Dunwich Horror"[/url].
